# FQHESphereMonteCarlo

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereMonteCarlo`

```text
FQHESphereMonteCarlo, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereMonteCarlo [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 6)
    -l, --lzmax : twice the maximum angular momentum per particle (default value = 15)
    --interaction-params : File containing parameters of interaction
    --list-wavefunctions : list all available test wave fuctions
    -b, --background-only : print background energy, and exit
    -o, --output : file to write a log of results
    --plot : plot effective interaction to file and exit
    --nbr-points : number points in plot (default value = 250)
    -c, --correlations : sample correlation function
    --corr-resolution : number of bins for correlation function (default value = 250)
    --corr-highres-range : number of bins to magnify at small r (default value = 0)
    --corr-highres-factor : ratio by which to inrease density of bins in high res area (default value = 3)
    --corr-length : correlation function to print distances in absolute length

Monte-Carlo options:
    -i, --nbr-iter : number of Monte Carlo iterations (default value = 10000)
    -d, --sample-density : number of Monte Carlo microsteps between iterations (-1=NbrParticles) (default value = -1)
    --thermalize : number of microsteps used for thermalization (default value = 2500)
    --nbr-display : number of intermediate results displayed (default value = 10)
    --randomSeed : random seed for internal random number generator (default value = -1)

analytical wave function options:
    --test-wavefunction : name of the test wave fuction
    --nbr-flux : number of quantum flux attached to each particle (laughlin and *cf only) (value must be greater than 0, default value = 1)
    --cluster-size : number of particles per cluster (read only) (value must be greater than 2, default value = 3)
    --nbr-level : number of pseudo Landau levels (filledcf only) (value must be greater than 1, default value = 1)
    --cf-file : name of the file describing the composite fermion state (genericcf only)
    --MR-coeff : coefficient for Moore-Read contribution (pairedcf only) (default value = 1)
    --pair-coeff : sequence of pairing coefficients (pairedcf only)
    --pair-compatibility : adopt old conventions for normalisation (pairedcf only)
    --fermion-state : generate a fermionic wavefunction (RR)
    --CF-levels : number of CF levels to fill (><0) (SLBS) (default value = -2)
    --Jz-Value : Total angular momentum Jz (hund only) (default value = 0)
    --hund-L2 : Total angular momentum J if less than maximal (hund only) (default value = -1)
    --JM-Values : Angular momentum J and projection on z axis J,M (paired2QH only)
    --QHMC-iter : Number of MC steps for internal MC (paired2QH only) (default value = 1000)

sampling function options:
    --list-sampling-functions : list all available sampling fuctions
    --sampler : name of the test wave fuction
    --laughlin-exponent : power to which the jastrow factors in sampling function are raised (default value = 2)

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
